name: UKGarage
description: Tempo-synced 2-step UK Garage kit. Hold to run. X grows ghost notes (soft snares/rims between the backbone); Y thickens hats and pushes toward Fill. Flick top-right for a one-bar Fill. Ghost notes are the groove.

params.name: GHOST
params.detail: Ghost-note / hand density (soft snares and rims between main hits)

params.name: FILL
params.detail: Hat density and fill energy (rolls, extra kicks)
